title: SocialPublishingReview 1.0.0 (social-publishing-review-v1)
description: What a model found when it read ONE package revision against the sources of its film and the profile of its channel. It changes nothing and approves nothing. A list with nothing in it is [], a suggestion that does not exist is null, and a string is never empty.

summary.description: What was read and what stands out, in a few sentences.

findings.description: [] when nothing was found. Ids F1, F2, ... each once.

location.description: The part of the package the finding is about; `package` for the package as a whole.

severity.description: How much it matters before posting. It holds nothing back: a person decides.

source_refs.description: Values of input.refs[].ref the finding rests on; [] when it rests on the package alone.

suggestion.description: What to change, in words. null when there is nothing to propose.

not_reviewed.description: What could not be reviewed from the input, each named plainly — the picture of the film when no picture was given, for one. [] when everything was read.
